description: Privileged bridge helpers. Capability methods go through tbx.invoke so adding one needs no schema change.

functions.name: readBridgeFile
functions.description: Read <profile>/tbmcp-bridge.json, or null when the daemon has not written it yet.

functions.name: writeStatus
functions.description: Write a startup report to <profile>/tbmcp-addon-status.json for tbmcp doctor.

functions.name: grantOptionalPermission
functions.description: Grant one of this add-on's own optional_permissions without a user gesture.

functions.name: keepAlive
functions.description: Stop Thunderbird suspending the background page, which would tear down the bridge.

functions.name: appInfo
functions.description: Application name, version, buildID, locale and the profile/install directories.

functions.name: availableModules
functions.description: Which privileged capability modules loaded and which methods they expose.

functions.name: globalIndexEnabled
functions.description: Whether Thunderbird's global message indexer is enabled (full-text search depends on it).

functions.name: writeFile
functions.description: Write bytes into a directory on this machine, refusing path separators in the filename.

functions.name: invoke
functions.description: Call a privileged capability method by name, e.g. "prefs.set".
